caption: The drawing features three main objects on a plain, off-white background. In the upper half of the composition, there is a black line drawing of a garment, specifically a skirt or underskirt, depicted in a slightly angled position to illustrate its shape. The garment flares outward at the bottom and is decorated near the hem with horizontal patterned bands. Below the garment, occupying the center of the page, are two rectangular panels placed one above the other. The upper panel is larger and filled with a densely packed, repeating black and white geometric pattern featuring circles, diamonds, and crisscrossing lines. The lower panel is narrower, containing a similar but less densely arranged version of the pattern, with repeating motifs that include circles and lines in black and white. The drawing utilizes black ink for all detailing and patterns, and there is a small set of initials, "L.N", in the bottom right corner of the paper.
title: Petticoat
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
